description: Excavation in earth for foundations, measured as the pit's volume including working space
Paint to surfaces, measured as the painted face net of scheduled openings
Plaster to surfaces, measured as the finished face net of scheduled openings
Brickwork in walls, measured as the wall face net of scheduled openings by its nominal thickness
Plain cement concrete blinding under foundations, measured as the laid volume
Bored cast-in-situ piles installed, counted as members
Boring for cast-in-situ piles, measured along the bored length below cut-off
Reinforced cement concrete cast in place, measured net of its reinforcement
Formwork to reinforced cement concrete, measured as the contact area of the cast face
Reinforcement steel in place, measured as nominal mass with laps billed beside the net
